live.instructions: Official Griddo backoffice documentation for content authors and site administrators: pages, modules, templates, content types, forms, media gallery, roles and publishing. Search these docs before answering any question about using Griddo and cite the URLs returned. The Spanish corpus is primary; pass lang:'en' when the user writes in English. Use get_griddo_editor_doc when a snippet is not enough. These docs describe the backoffice, not the assistant you run in. Not for developer questions (@griddo/core, schemas, module code, API, SDK): those belong to the separate Griddo DX Docs MCP.

tools.name: search_griddo_editor_docs
tools.title: Search Griddo editor docs
tools.description: Search the official Griddo documentation for content authors and site administrators (the Griddo backoffice, Author Experience: pages, modules, templates, content types, forms, media gallery, roles, publishing). Returns ranked excerpts with the canonical URL of each page. Use this before answering any question about how to do something in the Griddo backoffice, and cite the URLs you get back. Do NOT use it for developer questions about @griddo/core hooks and components, schema or module code, the Griddo API or the SDK: that is Developer Experience documentation, covered by the separate Griddo DX Docs MCP server.

query.description: Natural-language query or keywords. Spanish or English.

lang.description: Documentation language. Spanish is the primary, most complete version; pass 'en' when the user writes in English.

tools.name: get_griddo_editor_doc
tools.title: Get a Griddo editor docs page
tools.description: Fetch the full Markdown of one Griddo backoffice (Author Experience) documentation page by its path, as returned by search_griddo_editor_docs or list_griddo_editor_docs. Use it when the search excerpt is not enough to answer accurately.

path.description: Page path, e.g. '/editor/anadir-imagen'. The '.md' suffix, a leading slash and a full https://docs.griddo.io URL are all accepted.

tools.name: list_griddo_editor_docs
tools.title: List Griddo editor docs pages
tools.description: List every page of the Griddo backoffice (Author Experience) documentation, grouped by section, with title and URL. Use it to get oriented before searching, or when the user asks what the documentation covers.
